# olivares_workspace (Resource)

A sessions-module workspace in the Olivares AI control plane: a named isolation boundary for sessions. There is no update API, so any writable attribute change forces replacement. Authoring requires sessions:workspace:admin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Workspaces are the unit that scoped RBAC grants, budgets and deployments attach to.
resource "olivares_workspace" "dev" {
  name        = "development"
  description = "Development workspace for experimentation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable workspace name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional workspace description.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID for this resource, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the workspace was created.
- `ref` (String) Server-assigned workspace ref (the unique identifier).
- `status` (String) Server-assigned workspace status.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the workspace was last updated.
